mainEntity.name: What is the step-by-step process for planning and building an in-law suite?

acceptedAnswer.text: An in-law addition project begins with an initial consultation and site evaluation to review your property layout, budget, and family goals. Bay City Remodeling & Bathrooms then develops architectural plans, design specifications, and scope requirements, including accessibility needs and exterior blending. Once plans are finalized, necessary building permits are submitted to the local building department. After permit approval, construction proceeds through foundation work, framing, plumbing and electrical rough-ins, drywall installation, exterior finishing like stucco, and interior fixtures. A final walk-through verifies that every detail aligns with the agreed project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process moves from initial consultation and layout planning through permitting, framing, rough-in mechanicals, drywall, interior finishing, and the final walk-through.
